errors.text_span: 旨在评估各方法在蒙古语语音识别任务中对说话人特征建模的有效性
errors.evidence: This part of the description infers the specific purpose and context (Mongolian speech recognition) which is not explicitly available from the chart image itself. The chart only shows a comparison of EDR for different models without this context.

errors.text_span: 各测试集EDR值稳定在22–24%之间
errors.evidence: The description states that the EDR values for DNN-HMM are stable between 22-24%. However, the chart shows that for Test3, the value is approximately 20%, and for Test4, it is approximately 24.5%, both of which are outside the stated range.

The description incorrectly interprets the data by stating that LSTM-HMM performs the weakest. In fact, LSTM-HMM has the lowest EDR (Error Rate) across most tests, which signifies the best performance, not the weakest. The reference description confirms this, stating this model '表现最优' (performed optimally).
The description states that the EDR for LSTM-HMM fluctuates within the 10-13% range. However, for Test5, the value is approximately 13.5%, which is outside this range.

The description claims that the End-to-End method performs better than LSTM-HMM in Test3 and Test4. This is a misinterpretation; in those tests, the End-to-End method has a higher EDR (e.g., ~18.5% vs ~11.8% in Test3), which indicates worse performance, not better.
